title: fix(core): an import upsert finds its match through the organization unique index instead of scanning the table per row
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi95VnesQZBWZFEkawsaWFyuA)_
Fixes #31812

Clause-②: yes (widening) — @objectstack/core gains resolveTenantFieldName, DEFAULT_TENANT_FIELD and isFederatedObject (moved from @objectstack/objectql, which re-exports the same bindings)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：导入和外部同步做 upsert / update 时，按 key 找已有记录的那条查询，现在会带上调用方所在组织（`organization_id = ? AND key = ?`），能用上 (organization_id, key) 唯一索引。
- 为什么改：默认的 single 形态下引擎读数据不加组织条件，这条查询只带 key，每一行都扫全表。实测 5 万行的表上 upsert 只有每秒 128 行，而且表越大越慢。
- 风险与回滚：只会把匹配范围收窄到本组织，不会放宽。旧库里组织为 NULL 的残留行不再被匹配（按 ADR-0131 D1）。group 形态下只匹配当前组织的记录。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/core/src/utils/import-runner.ts` 的 `matchScopeOf` 和 `findExisting`；`packages/core/src/security/tenant-field.ts`（从 objectql 原样下移的规则）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/import-upsert-match-organization.test.ts`，3 条全过，第一条断言 SQLite 的执行计划是按唯一索引 SEARCH。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `runImport`'s match lookup (`findExisting`, used by update and upsert, dry run included) now adds the target's tenant column, set to the context's `tenantId`, beside the key fields. The organization is the one a created row is stamped with (the engine's write target in every posture), so the lookup finds exactly the record an insert of that key would collide with.
- The tenant column is read once per import from the target's declaration (`p.getMetaItem`), by the engine's own rule: a federated (`external`) object has none, then `resolveTenantFieldName` decides (`tenancy.enabled: false` → none; a declared `tenancy.tenantField` the object has; else `organization_id`).
- The lookup stays the key alone, exactly as before, when the context has no organization, the protocol has no `getMetaItem`, the declaration read fails, the object is federated, or it has no tenant column. A key set that already names the tenant column keeps the row's own value.
- `resolveTenantFieldName`, `DEFAULT_TENANT_FIELD` and `isFederatedObject` move from `@objectstack/objectql` down to `@objectstack/core` (`security/tenant-field.ts`), following ADR-0138 D4's move of `resolveSystemWriteOrganization`. objectql's `tenancy/system-write-organization.ts` and `federated-object.ts` re-export the same bindings; no behaviour change there. The platform-object tenancy census now loads the predicate, and reads its header, from the new file.

## Why

Step 0, measured on `origin/main` `6be71abc` through the real `runImport` → protocol `findData` → `SqlDriver` (better-sqlite3):

- `single` posture (the default when multi-org is off): the lookup reached SQLite as `select * from T where external_id = ? order by id asc limit ?`, plan `SCAN`. The engine's read scope (`engine-driver-options.ts` `driverReadScope` → `computeTenantLayer0Verdict`) is `none` under `single` by design (ADR-0131 D11).
- `isolated` posture: the same call reached SQLite as `organization_id = ? and external_id = ?`, plan `SEARCH … USING INDEX uniq_T_organization_id_external_id`. The index is the plain-column form, so the cause is (a): no organization predicate reaches the driver under `single`.

Shape, by seat ruling: `organization_id = ? AND KEY` only. An `OR organization_id IS NULL` leg was measured and rejected (readings below): on SQLite it forfeits the index on every table created since ADR-0131 D1 (tenant column NOT NULL).

## Tests

- `packages/core/src/utils/import-runner-match-organization.test.ts` (new, 18 cases): the `where` is tenant column + key for a job context and a session context, upsert and update, dry run, ordered key sets, a declared `tenancy.tenantField`; the declaration is read once per import. CONTROL (the lookup is the key alone and the stored row still matches): no tenant column, `tenancy.enabled: false`, an external object, a declared tenantField the object lacks, no / blank / absent organization, no `getMetaItem`, a failing declaration read, and a key set that names the tenant column. RED on main: 8 failed, 10 passed.
- `packages/rest/src/import-upsert-match-organization.test.ts` (new, 3 cases, real `SqlDriver`, `single` posture): the lookup SQL is `where organization_id = ? and external_id = ?` with bindings `[org, key]`, and its `EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN` is `SEARCH … USING INDEX uniq_…_organization_id_external_id`. CONTROL: a key with no index (`code`) still matches and updates; an object with no tenant column (`systemFields: false`) matches on the key alone. RED on main: 2 failed, 1 passed.
- Identity pins in `packages/objectql/src/system-write-organization.test.ts`: objectql's module and barrel exports of the three moved names are the `@objectstack/core` bindings.

Forced test edits:

- `packages/objectql/src/audit-stamp-skip-automations.test.ts`: its stub driver stored rows without the tenant column, which every real driver stamps from `DriverOptions.tenantId` (`injectTenantOnInsert`). Case (c) imports a row and then updates it by `code`; with the lookup now scoped by `organization_id`, the stub's row (no column) no longer matched (`NO_MATCH`). The stub now stamps `organization_id` from `options.tenantId` on create; audit columns stay the hook's alone.
- `packages/objectql/src/federated-injected-column-readers.test.ts`: two `READERS` rows named the definitions that moved out of objectql (the module-level row of `tenancy/system-write-organization.ts` and its `resolveTenantFieldName` row), so the census reported them stale. Rows removed; the header says the definitions live in core.

## Acceptance notes

- **Legacy NULL-organization rows.** A database built before ADR-0131 D1 may still hold tenant columns that are nullable, and a reported NULL row in one. After this PR such a row is not matched by an upsert or update import; a row with that key is created in the caller's organization instead. This follows D1 as amended (ruling of record `6328195425`): "NULL is not a state, and nothing reads a NULL tenant value as an owner". #24919 measured 0 NULL-organization rows in every store it read.
- **`group` posture.** The match is now the record in the active organization, the one a create from that context writes. It no longer reaches a same-key row in another member organization (updating that row would be a cross-organization write).
- **Not covered: a job with no declared `organization`.** `jobExecutionContext(undefined)` gives `{ isSystem: true }` with no `tenantId`, so that pull keeps the key-only lookup. #31778 G9's measured setup is that path; it is #31823.
- An explicit field permission that marks `organization_id` unreadable for the importing user would now refuse the lookup at the predicate guard (`assertReadableQueryFields`), since the lookup filters on it. Read only, not measured; no shipped permission set does this.
- Out of scope, reported, not changed: the protocol's `findData` also runs a `count(*)` over the same `where` for every lookup (it now benefits from the same index probe); plugin-security and plugin-sharing each keep their own `isFederatedObject` copy (`federated-phantom-anchors.ts`).

## Verification

Head: `003b09d5` (the changeset declaration line only, on top of `e9f6ba17`, which merged `origin/main` at `0a4d8b18`). Each reading below names the commit it was taken on; on `003b09d5` the changeset gates `check-changeset-no-major` (with this body as the event payload), `check-adr-0087-registration` (and `--self-test`), `check-empty-changeset`, `check-declaration-mirrors` and `check:changeset-gate-self-tests` exit 0.

<details><summary>Timing: rows/s at 10,000 and 50,000 rows, before and after</summary>

Real `ObjectQL` + `SqlDriver` (better-sqlite3 `:memory:`), `single` posture, context `{ isSystem: true, tenantId }`. The table is pre-seeded to N rows; then one upsert of 1,000 rows (500 update existing keys spread over the table, 500 create new keys). Shared-box readings under the verify lock.

| table rows | before (`6be71abc`) | after (`a5aeb1a1`) |
|---|---|---|
| 10,000 | 1,000 rows in 2,781 ms = **360 rows/s** | 1,000 rows in 1,440 ms = **694 rows/s** |
| 50,000 | 1,000 rows in 7,794 ms = **128 rows/s** | 1,000 rows in 1,166 ms = **857 rows/s** |

Before, throughput falls with table size (each lookup scans). After, it is flat.
</details>

<details><summary>Query plans: SQLite and Postgres</summary>

SQLite (better-sqlite3), unique index `(organization_id, external_id)`, 20,000 rows:

| shape | tenant column NOT NULL (since D1) | tenant column nullable (pre-D1) |
|---|---|---|
| `organization_id = ? and external_id = ?` (this PR) | SEARCH USING INDEX (organization_id=? AND external_id=?) | SEARCH USING INDEX |
| `(organization_id = ? or organization_id is null) and external_id = ?` | SCAN | MULTI-INDEX OR, two SEARCH |
| `organization_id is null and external_id = ?` | SCAN | SEARCH |
| `external_id = ?` (main) | SCAN | SCAN |

Postgres 16, 100,000 rows, ANALYZE:

- `organization_id = 'org_a' and external_id = 'E7'` (this PR): `Index Scan using u_nn … Index Cond: ((organization_id = 'org_a') AND (external_id = 'E7'))`.
- the OR-NULL form: BitmapOr of two Bitmap Index Scans (both NOT NULL and nullable).
- `external_id = 'E7'` (main): `Seq Scan … Filter: (external_id = 'E7')`.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation</summary>

On `a5aeb1a1`. Mutation (committed fix first, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`): the line that adds the tenant column to the lookup's `where` replaced by a marker statement (`ABLATED_31812`). `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core build`; `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs @objectstack/core ABLATED_31812` → marker in `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.cjs`.

- rest real-driver test: 2 failed, 1 passed (the CONTROL for the object with no tenant column stays green).
- core unit test: 7 failed, 11 passed (the "declaration read once" case stays green: the read still happens).

Restore: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty; rebuilt; `--absent` preflight: dist reading passed (marker in 0 of 14 built files); its tree reading exited 3 only because two untracked probe files were still in `packages/rest/src` (removed right after, never committed). rest test after restore: 3 passed.
</details>

<details><summary>Suites and gates</summary>

Package suites, before the merge (head `88c2e6a2`, then the stub fix `fdd5c8d8`), all green:

- `@objectstack/core` test: Test Files 140 passed, Tests 3212 passed.
- `@objectstack/objectql` test: Tests 11817 passed (the first run had 1 failure, the audit stub case named under Forced test edits; green after it).
- `@objectstack/rest` test: Test Files 397 passed, Tests 7636 passed, 332 skipped.
- Downstream `runImport` consumers: `service-automation` connector-pull 27 passed; `plugin-auth` admin-import-users / account-invitation-marker / durability-swallow-repair 120 passed; `service-messaging` notification-template integration 38 passed.
- Typecheck `@objectstack/core`, `@objectstack/objectql`, `@objectstack/rest`: exit 0.

After merging `origin/main` (head `e9f6ba17`), rebuilt (`turbo run build --filter=./packages/** --filter=./examples/**`, 82 tasks successful), then:

- core `import-runner-match-organization.test.ts` 18 passed; rest `import-upsert-match-organization.test.ts` 3 passed; objectql `system-write-organization`, `federated-object`, `federated-injected-column-readers`, `audit-stamp-skip-automations` 53 passed; the three typechecks exit 0.
- `eslint --no-inline-config packages/core packages/objectql packages/rest`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 88 derived families, each run on `e9f6ba17`, all exit 0. `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` first exited 3 (its fixture commit was not in the shallow clone); after `git fetch --depth=1 origin 621a4876…` it exited 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 88 derived, 88 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- The edited census script: `check-platform-object-tenancy-census.mjs --self-test` passed and the gate reads 99 platform-namespace objects, 51 in reach, 48 outside, matching the tree.

Dogfood battery: not run locally (no `!` in the title, no `(narrowing)` arm); CI's queue run carries it.
</details>
